messages:
harry: Hey, running the quickstart (node-starter) locally and the first call just hangs after '202 Accepted' in the logs. Repro steps: npm run start -> POST /v1/chat -> logs show `202 Accepted` and then no response to client for >30s. Anyone seen this? sample and org are fresh, invited user.
maria: Did you accept the org billing invite? New workspaces need billing to mint service tokens.
harry: I can see the billing toast in the web console but I already added card. The toast says 'Enable billing to finish provisioning' though charge was successful.
aj: Can you paste the curl output? Also which key are you using — user API key or service token from the sample?
harry: curl output:
```
HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":"workspace_unprovisioned","detail":"billing:pending","hint":"visiting https://console/redwood/activate will finish setup"}
```
harry: But in console billing shows 'Active', and web UI shows a small toast to finish setup (it has a 'Complete setup' button). When I click it says 'Already in progress'.
maria: Ok that's a known edge: if billing is added while async provisioning is ongoing, the service-token issuer won't mint until org provisioning finishes. Usually resolves in ~1-2min. Did you try flushing local credential cache? The SDK caches service token for 10s during startup.
harry: I cleared ~/.redwood/credcache and restarted sample — still the 402.
samir: @maria could this be the propagation race we saw last week with the payment webhook and the provisioning job? Could need a retry endpoint.
maria: Yup. There's also a temporary workaround: use your user API key (from profile) instead of service token so the call succeeds immediately, or hit /orgs/:id/refresh-provision endpoint (internal) if you have perms.
aj: For clarity, if anyone else hits this: 1) confirm billing charge in stripe dashboard; 2) try user API key; 3) clear SDK cache + restart; 4) if persists, ping #devex with org id and i'll trigger a manual provision.
harry: Using user key works — sample gets immediate 200 and chat tokens stream. Thanks. Do we want to add clearer error text in SDK (instead of generic 402) and a quick tip to use user key while provisioning?
maria: Yes — please file a tiny DX issue: 'quickstart: clearer error + retry hint for workspace_provisioning' and we should add a small retry on 402 in the Node SDK with a 10s backoff (but only for first-call flows).
aj: I'll put up a PR with improved message and a one-off local debug CLI: `rw devex provision:retry <org>`.
harry: Thanks all :rocket:
devex-bot: Note: ticket #DX-824 created by aj to add clearer error text and retry logic.
billing-bot: Stripe webhook shows charge succeeded at 2026-03-23T15:02:11Z for org org_12345 — provisioning job queued.
